claims.quote: We stumbled into the schoolyard with five minutes left before the bell.
Under the pine, Finn sat on his backpack, knees swinging, relief softening his face when he saw us.
claims.value: sitting on his backpack under the pine tree, knees swinging, relieved

claims.quote: "Knights of the Cafeteria," Ms. Ramirez called, smiling. "Report to the lunch table, heroes."
claims.value: Ms. Ramirez bestows title 'Knights of the Cafeteria' with line: 'Report to the lunch table, heroes.'

claims.quote: In the distance, near the far hedge by the bike rack, Mr. Bennett stood with his hands in his pockets, watching too; his face had that softened look we'd seen before, like a door left ajar.
claims.value: near the far hedge by the bike rack; hands in pockets; softened expression

claims.quote: Goliath lay on the bench by the pine tree, head on his paws and watching us with the patient expression he'd used on the bridge.
claims.value: bench near the pine tree; Goliath watches from bench

claims.quote: Mara stamped the back of our homework flag into Finn's hands and declared, as if reading from a scroll, "By order of the King's Road, these knights are hereby charged to eat heartily and share snacks when necessary."
claims.value: Mara formally bestows playful charge, stamps flag into Finn's hands
